title: neoneoneoneo
description: modpack for neoforge. for my frinds and I with create mod and a bunch of addons and some stuff for biomes
body:
this is a modpack for minecraft neoforge using vertion 1.21.1 and has create, some optomizations, and a lot more. all you need to do it install prism lancher and, then add instance, import, then select the modpack this is more optomized than neoneoneo Re
some of the mods include farmers delight, create, create crafts and additions, create man of many planes nurismatics, distant horizens exposure some season and biome mods like oh the biomes we've been, travelers backpack and many many more this modpack unlike my remake of this mod neoneoneo re should be able to create new world without needing to import one from a difrent instance, i have some mods that add better sounds or visuals like sounds and particulars reforged and a sound physics mod. i recomend adding these for both my neoneoneo modpacks, adding cool rain, graphine (only if needed) and whatever you would like, though its already not a super stable modpack (for me at least)
